stories.title: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
stories.summary: With ia.i, a conversational interface, and the IARA governance platform, Itaú is applying its AI First strategy to customers and employees — in one of Brazil’s most regulated sectors.

stories.title: Benefit Street Partners answers questions faster with Codex
stories.summary: Anant Kumar builds tools to compare loan valuations and analyze credit agreements, using Codex for code review and faster follow-ups.

stories.title: Stack Overflow for Agents triples signups with ChatGPT plugin
stories.summary: Two engineers shipped Stack Overflow for Agents in a few weeks with Codex, and its ChatGPT plugin helped drive up to 10× growth in agent creation.

stories.title: Bringing GPT-Rosalind to academic research labs
stories.summary: Introducing the Rosalind Academic Plan, offering eligible academic labs sponsored access to GPT-Rosalind and tools to advance life sciences research.

stories.title: Teaching students to think and learn through questions
stories.summary: Celebrate Teachers’ Day with AI for Educators in Brazilian Portuguese and see how Study Mode can help teachers support active, step-by-step learning.
